name: Topo Designs

prices.note: products.json, 221 listings (one per colour): 63 marked down and 8 sold out excluded, 99 duffels, travel bags, organisers, dopp kits, briefcases, bike and clip bags excluded; 51 regular-price backpacks, crossbody bags, hip packs and totes, median $59. Low: Ripstop Belt Bag $39; Mini Shoulder Bag $49; Mountain Waist Pack $54; Block Bag (3.5L) $69; high: Topo Designs x Toyota Rover Trail Pack $199. Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (reusable/shopping bags, totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, pouches, organisers, wallets, straps, charms, lunch boxes excluded.

notes: About: in 2008 Jedd Rose began sewing packs in his Fort Collins basement; co-founder Mark Hansen; uses 'materials like organic cotton and recycled nylons' (https://topodesigns.com/pages/about-us). Store meta: Denver, Colorado, USD (https://topodesigns.com/meta.json).

Free US shipping on $100+; returns of unused items within 30 days for a refund (https://topodesigns.com/policies/refund-policy). Stores: Denver Flagship, Denver Base Camp, Fort Collins, Hayes Valley San Francisco (https://topodesigns.com/pages/our-retail-stores). 'Reasonable lifetime warranty against defects in materials and workmanship' on gear (https://topodesigns.com/pages/warranty-and-repairs). Mini Shoulder Bag: strap removes or wraps through back loops to wear it as a fanny pack (products.json).
